name: judge_bench_stem_code_binarized
description: A dataset for evaluating models on STEM coding tasks with binarized (correct/incorrect) labels. It measures a model's ability to produce correct code or judge correctness of code solutions across STEM problems. The benchmark emphasizes binary correctness evaluation rather than open-ended code quality.
reputation: A niche, task-specific dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community adoption outside specialized code-evaluation research.
